Saad. Naseehat waale Quran ki qasam
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh kuffaar ghuroor aur ikhtilaaf mein pade hue hain
Hum ne un se pehle kitni naslon ko tabaah kar diya hai, phir unhon ne faryaad ki lekin koi chhutkaara mumkin nahin tha
Aur inhein ta'ajjub hai ke unhi mein se koi daraane waala kaise aa gaya, aur kaafiron ne saaf keh diya ke yeh to jaadoogar aur jhoota hai
Kya is ne saare khudaaon ko jod kar ek khuda bana diya hai? Yeh to intehaai ta'ajjub-khez baat hai
Aur un mein se ek giroh yeh keh kar chal diya ke chalo apne khudaaon par qaaim raho, ke is mein in ki koi gharaz paayi jaati hai
Hum ne to agle daur ki ummaton mein yeh baatein nahin suni hain, aur yeh koi khud-saakhta baat maaloom hoti hai
Kya hum sab ke darmiyaan tanha inhi par kitaab naazil ho gayi hai? Haqeeqat yeh hai ke inhein hamaari kitaab mein shak hai, balke asl yeh hai ke abhi unhon ne azaab ka maza hi nahin chakha hai
Kya un ke paas aap ke saahib-e-izzat o ata Parwardigar ki rehmat ka koi khazaana hai
Ya un ke paas zameen o aasmaan aur us ke maa-bain ka ikhtiyaar hai? To yeh seedhi laga kar aasmaan par chadh jaayein
Tamaam girohon mein se ek giroh yahaan bhi shikast khaane waala hai
Is se pehle qaum-e-Nooh, qaum-e-Aad aur meikhon waala Fir'aun sab guzar chuke hain
Aur Samood, qaum-e-Loot, jangal waale log, yeh sab giroh guzar chuke hain
In mein se har ek ne rasool ki takzeeb ki to un par hamaara azaab saabit ho gaya
Yeh sirf is baat ka intezaar kar rahe hain ke ek aisi chinghaad buland ho jaaye jis se adna mohlat bhi na mil sake
Aur yeh kehte hain ke Parwardigar! Hamaara qismat ka likha hua roz-e-hisaab se pehle hi humein de de
Aap un ki baaton par sabr karein aur hamaare bande Dawood alaihis-salaam ko yaad karein jo saahib-e-taaqat bhi the aur behadd rujoo karne waale bhi the
Hum ne un ke liye pahaadon ko musakhkhar kar diya tha ke un ke saath subah o shaam tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar karein
Aur parindon ko un ke gird jama kar diya tha, sab un ke farmaanbardaar the
Aur hum ne un ke mulk ko mazboot bana diya tha aur inhein hikmat aur saheeh faisle ki quwwat ata kar di thi
Aur kya aap ke paas un jhagda karne waalon ki khabar aayi hai jo mehraab ki deewaar phaand kar aa gaye the

Ke jab woh Dawood alaihis-salaam ke saamne haazir hue to unhon ne khauf mehsoos kiya, aur un logon ne kaha ke aap darein nahin, hum do fareeq hain jis mein ek ne doosre par zulm kiya hai. Aap haq ke saath faisla kar dein aur na-insaafi na karein, aur humein seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar dein
Yeh hamaara bhai hai, is ke paas ninnaanwe dunbiyaan hain aur mere paas sirf ek hai. Yeh kehta hai ke woh bhi mere hawaale kar de, aur is baat mein sakhti se kaam leta hai

Dawood alaihis-salaam ne kaha ke us ne tumhaari dunbi ka sawaal kar ke tum par zulm kiya hai, aur bahut se shuraka aise hi hain ke un mein se ek doosre par zulm karta hai, ilaawa un logon ke jo saahibaan-e-imaan o amal-e-saaleh hain, aur woh bahut kam hain. Aur Dawood alaihis-salaam ne yeh khayaal kiya ke hum ne un ka imtehaan liya hai, lihaaza unhon ne apne Rab se istighfaar kiya aur sajde mein gir pade aur hamaari taraf saraapa tawajjoh ban gaye
To hum ne is baat ko maaf kar diya, aur hamaare nazdeek un ke liye taqarrub aur behtareen baazgasht hai

Aye Dawood! Hum ne tum ko zameen mein apna jaanasheen banaaya hai, lihaaza tum logon ke darmiyaan haq ke saath faisla karo aur khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karo ke woh raah-e-Khuda se munharif kar dein. Beshak jo log raah-e-Khuda se bhatak jaate hain un ke liye shadeed azaab hai ke unhon ne roz-e-hisaab ko yaksar nazar-andaaz kar diya hai
Aur hum ne aasmaan aur zameen aur us ke darmiyaan ki makhlooqaat ko bekaar nahin paida kiya hai. Yeh to sirf kaafiron ka khayaal hai, aur kaafiron ke liye Jahannam mein wail ki manzil hai
Kya hum imaan laane waale aur nek amal karne waalon ko zameen mein fasaad barpa karne waalon jaisa qaraar de dein, ya saahibaan-e-taqwa ko faasiq o faajir afraad jaisa qaraar de dein
Yeh ek mubaarak kitaab hai jise hum ne aap ki taraf naazil kiya hai taake yeh log is ki aayaton mein ghaur o fikr karein aur saahibaan-e-aql naseehat haasil karein
Aur hum ne Dawood alaihis-salaam ko Sulaimaan alaihis-salaam jaisa farzand ata kiya jo behtareen banda aur hamaari taraf rujoo karne waala tha
Jab un ke saamne shaam ke waqt behtareen aseel ghode pesh kiye gaye
To unhon ne kaha ke main zikr-e-Khuda ki bina par khair ko dost rakhta hoon, yahaan tak ke woh ghode daudte daudte nigaahon se ojhal ho gaye
To unhon ne kaha ke ab inhein waapas palataao, us ke baad un ki pindliyon aur gardanon ko malna shuroo kar diya
Aur hum ne Sulaimaan alaihis-salaam ka imtehaan liya jab un ki kursi par ek be-jaan jism ko daal diya, to phir unhon ne Khuda ki taraf tawajjoh ki
Aur kaha ke Parwardigar! Mujhe maaf farma aur ek aisa mulk ata farma jo mere baad kisi ke liye sazaawaar na ho, ke tu behtareen ata karne waala hai
To hum ne hawaaon ko musakhkhar kar diya ke unhi ke hukm se jahaan jaana chaahte the narm raftaar se chalti thin
Aur shayaateen mein se tamaam me'maaron aur ghota-khoron ko taabe' bana diya
Aur un shayaateen ko bhi jo sarkashi ki bina par zanjeeron mein jakde hue the
Yeh sab meri ata hai, ab chaahe logon ko de do ya apne paas rakho, tum se hisaab na hoga
Aur un ke liye hamaare yahaan taqarrub ka darja hai aur behtareen baazgasht hai
Aur hamaare bande Ayyoob alaihis-salaam ko yaad karo jab unhon ne apne Parwardigar ko pukaara ke Shaitaan ne mujhe badi takleef aur aziyyat pahunchaayi hai
To hum ne kaha ke zameen par pairon ko ragdo, dekho yeh nahaane aur peene ke liye behtareen thanda paani hai
Aur hum ne inhein un ke ahl o ayaal ata kar diye aur utne hi aur bhi de diye. Yeh hamaari rehmat aur saahibaan-e-aql ke liye ibrat o naseehat hai

Aur Ayyoob! Tum apne haathon mein seenkon ka muttha le kar us se maar do aur qasam ki khilaaf-warzi na karo. Hum ne Ayyoob alaihis-salaam ko saabir paaya hai, woh behtareen banda aur hamaari taraf rujoo karne waala hai
Aur Paighambar! Hamaare bande Ibraheem alaihis-salaam, Is'haaq alaihis-salaam aur Ya'qoob alaihis-salaam ka zikr kijiye jo saahibaan-e-quwwat aur saahibaan-e-baseerat the
Hum ne un ko aakhirat ki yaad ki sifat se mumtaaz qaraar diya tha
Aur woh hamaare nazdeek muntakhab aur nek bandon mein se the
Aur Ismaaeel alaihis-salaam aur Al-Yasa' alaihis-salaam aur Zul-Kifl alaihis-salaam ko bhi yaad kijiye, aur yeh sab nek bande the
Yeh ek naseehat hai, aur saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye behtareen baazgasht hai
Hameshgi ki jannatein jin ke darwaaze un ke liye khule hue honge
Wahaan takiya lagaaye chain se baithe honge aur tarah tarah ke meve aur sharaab talab karenge
Aur un ke pehlu mein neechi nazar waali hum-sinn biwiyaan hongi
Yeh woh cheezein hain jin ka roz-e-qiyaamat ke liye tum se waada kiya gaya hai
Yeh hamaara rizq hai jo khatm hone waala nahin hai
Yeh ek taraf hai, aur sarkashon ke liye badtareen baazgasht hai
Jahannam hai jis mein yeh waarid honge, aur woh badtareen thikaana hai
Yeh hai azaab, is ka maza chakhein: garm paani hai aur peep
Aur isi qism ki doosri cheezein bhi hain
Yeh tumhaari fauj hai, ise bhi tumhaare hamraah Jahannam mein thoons diya jaaega. Khuda un ka bhala na kare, aur yeh sab Jahannam mein jalne waale hain
Phir mureed apne peeron se kahenge: tumhaara bhala na ho, tum ne is azaab ko hamaare liye muhayya kiya hai, lihaaza yeh badtareen thikaana hai
Phir mazeed kahenge ke Khudaaya! Jis ne hum ko aage badhaaya hai us ke azaab ko Jahannam mein doguna kar de
Phir khud hi kahenge ke humein kya ho gaya hai ke hum un logon ko nahin dekhte jinhein shareer logon mein shumaar karte the
Hum ne na-haq un ka mazaaq udaaya tha, ya ab hamaari nigaahein un ki taraf se palat gayi hain
Yeh ahl-e-Jahannam ka baahami jhagda ek amr-e-barhaq hai
Aap keh dijiye ke main to sirf daraane waala hoon, aur Khuda-e-Waahid o Qahhaar ke ilaawa koi doosra khuda nahin hai
Wahi aasmaan o zameen aur un ki darmiyaani makhlooqaat ka Parwardigar aur saahib-e-izzat aur bahut zyaada bakhshne waala hai
Keh dijiye ke yeh Quran bahut badi khabar hai
Tum is se e'raaz kiye hue ho
Mujhe kya ilm hota ke aalam-e-baala mein kya behas ho rahi thi
Meri taraf to sirf yeh wahi aati hai ke main ek khula hua azaab-e-Ilaahi se daraane waala insaan hoon
Inhein yaad dilaaiye jab aap ke Parwardigar ne malaaika se kaha ke main geeli mitti se ek bashar banaane waala hoon
Jab use durust kar loon aur us mein apni rooh phoonk doon to tum sab sajde mein gir padna
To tamaam malaaika ne sajda kar liya
Ilaawa Iblees ke, ke woh akad gaya aur kaafiron mein ho gaya
To Khuda ne kaha: aye Iblees! Tere liye kya shai maane' hui ke tu use sajda kare jise main ne apne dast-e-qudrat se banaaya hai? Tu ne ghuroor ikhtiyaar kiya ya tu waaqai buland logon mein se hai
Us ne kaha ke main un se behtar hoon, tu ne mujhe aag se paida kiya hai aur inhein khaak se paida kiya hai
Irshaad hua ke yahaan se nikal ja, tu mardood hai
Aur yaqeenan tere oopar qiyaamat ke din tak meri la'nat hai
Us ne kaha: Parwardigar! Mujhe roz-e-qiyaamat tak ki mohlat bhi de de
Irshaad hua ke tujhe mohlat de di gayi hai
Magar ek mu'ayyan waqt ke din tak
Us ne kaha to phir teri izzat ki qasam! Main sab ko gumraah karoonga
Ilaawa tere un bandon ke jinhein tu ne khaalis bana liya hai
Irshaad hua to phir haq yeh hai, aur main to haq hi kehta hoon
Ke main Jahannam ko tujh se aur tere pairokaaron se bhar doonga
Aur Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke main apni tableegh ka koi ajr nahin chaahta aur na main banaawat karne waala ghalat-bayaan hoon
Yeh Quran to aalameen ke liye ek naseehat hai
Aur kuch dinon ke baad tum sab ko is ki haqeeqat maaloom ho jaaegi
